body:
## Goal

Resolve the sourced role/parent questions for exactly four #421 Greek location IDs: Mount Anthos under Agion Oros, and the island municipalities Poros, Ydra and Elafonisos under their three same-name single-child fallback province parents. Keep their Atlas IDs; assess source identity and territorial meaning before proposing any hierarchy or geometry action.

## Acceptance

- Inspect authoritative current legal and boundary sources for Mount Athos/Aghion Oros and the three named islands, with explicit dates, geometry role, license, identity and neighboring regional granularity.
- Map each exact location and its parent reference to sourced legal/geographic evidence; distinguish special local-government status from statutory outer geometry and distinguish fallback overlaps from a correct regional assignment.
- Retain lawful originals and exact hashes or provide exact restoration instructions; document per-ID supported/unresolved outcomes and bounded engineering handoffs.
- No shared hierarchy, IDs, geometry, claims, imports, publication, regional approval or sovereignty conclusion.

Blocked pending the exact #421 evidence packet. Proposed 2026-10-05; no earlier raised date is asserted.
